newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-Polish March yr/yr CPI below 17 pct-CSS.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Polish March yr/yr CPI below 17 pct-CSS.

text.p: Polish consumer prices are likely to grow 0.8-0.9 percent in March against 1.1 percent in February taking the year-on-year index below 17.0 percent from February's 17.3 percent, a senior government analyst said.

"I estimate that month-on-month inflation in March was 0.8-0.9 percent which pushed the year-on-year index to go below 17 percent," Tadeusz Chroscicki, chief analyst at the Government Centre for Strategic Studies (CSS) told Reuters.
"I also expect the year-on-year index to fall to 14.5 percent in June," Chroscicki said. @
Inflation was at 18.5 percent in December 1996 and the government aims to bring it down to 13 percent in December this year.
